title: Protocol to evaluate cell lineage stability of mouse natural and induced regulatory T cells using bisulfite sequencing
protocol: Set the 40–70 μm cell strainer on the 6 cm dish, and add 3 mL FACS buffer into them.
Transfer peripheral lymph nodes and spleen to the prepared cell strainer containing FACS buffer.
Mash the transferred tissues using a 3 mL syringe plunger in the dish.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge the sample at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 1 mL Red Blood Cell Lysing Buffer Hybri-Max.
Set the sample for 2 min at room temperature.
Add 9 mL FACS buffer to the lysed sample.
Centrifuge the sample at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 100 μL Mouse CD4 T Lymphocyte Enrichment Cocktail and 200 μL FACS buffer.
Set the enriched sample on ice for 15 min.
Centrifuge the sample at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 100 μL Streptavidin Particles Plus and 200 μL FACS buffer.
Set the sample on ice for 15 min.
Add 2 mL FACS buffer to the sample, transfer it to a 5 mL tube.
Place the tube on a Cell Separation Magnet for 6 min at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant to a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge the sample at 500 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 1 mL FACS buffer.
Stain the cells with the antibody cocktail.
Set the stained sample on ice for 15 minutes.
Wash the cells with FACS buffer.
Centrifuge the sample at 500 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 200 μL fixation buffer.
Set the fixed sample on ice for 30 minutes.
Wash the cells with permeabilization buffer.
Centrifuge the sample at 600 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the pellet with the intracellular antibody cocktail.
Wash the cells with FACS buffer.
Centrifuge the sample at 600 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 2 mL FACS buffer.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet with 2 mL FACS buffer.
Sort up to 100,000 cells into a 1.5 mL tube containing T cell culture medium using FACSAria II cell sorter.
Centrifuge the sample tube at 500 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the pellet with 400 μL Lysis buffer.
Add 2 μL Proteinase K solution to the tube.
Shake and incubate the tube at 1,300 rpm overnight at 55°C.
Add 400 μL PCI to the sample tube and vortex well.
Centrifuge it at 15,000 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Transfer the upper layer (400 μL aqueous layer) to the new 1.5 mL tube.
Repeat steps involving PCI addition and centrifugation.
Add 400 μL CIA to the sample tube and vortex well.
Centrifuge it at 15,000 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Transfer the upper layer (aqueous layer) to a new 1.5 mL tube.
Add 1 μL Ethachinmate, 40 μL 3 M sodium acetate and 1 mL 100% EtOH to the sample tube.
Mix thoroughly by gentle inversion.
Centrifuge it at 15,000 × g for 20 min at 15°C.
Discard the supernatant carefully.
Add 500 μL 80% EtOH to the sample tube.
Centrifuge it at 15,000 × g for 15 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant carefully.
Dry up pellet for 5 min.
Elute the pellet with 20 μL TE buffer.
Prepare the bisulfite solution according to Table 3 specifications.
Set the bisulfite solution at 80°C.
Add 2.2 μL of 3 M NaOH to each sample (20 μL).
Incubate the samples for 15 minutes at 37°C.
Add 220 μL of bisulfite solution to each sample tube.
Incubate the samples for 1 hour at 80°C.
Add 500 ng salmon sperm DNA solution and 240 μL Buffer PB to each sample tube.
Transfer the sample to the column.
Centrifuge the column at 15,000 × g for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Discard the flowthrough.
Add 200 μL Buffer PE to the column.
Centrifuge the column at 15,000 × g for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Repeat step 35.
Discard the flowthrough.
Set the column on a new 1.5 mL tube.
Add 50 μL 50 mM NaOH to the column.
Incubate the column at room temperature for 1 minute.
Centrifuge the column at 15,000 × g for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Set the sample for 30 minutes at 95°C for desulfonation.
Add 5 μL 1 M TrisHCl (pH7.5) to the sample.
Place the sample on ice.
Now the sample is ready for bisulfite PCR.
Pause point: The sample can be stored at 4°C until the next step.
Prepare the bisulfite PCR mix on ice until PCR.
Run the PCR program as specified.
Electrophoresis of the PCR products using 2% agarose gel.
Cut the aimed band in the gel and transfer the gel pieces to a 1.5 mL tube.
Pause point: Able to store the sample at -30°C for up to one month.
Dissolve and remove the gel from the silica beads (QIAEX II Suspension).
Wash with QIAEX II Silica Beads.
Elute the pellet with 8 μL TE buffer.
Perform ligation of PCR products for TA cloning.
Prepare the vector ligation mix in a 1.5 mL tube.
Place the tube on ice until the ligation step is required.
Incubate the tube at 16°C for 30 minutes to 2 hours for ligation.
Add optimized DH5α competent cells solution to the ligation mixture.
Place the tube on ice for 10 minutes after adding competent cells.
Transfer the tube to a water bath at 42°C for 45 seconds.
Return the tube to ice immediately after heat shock.
Add SOC solution (10 times the volume of the sample) to the tube.
Incubate the tube in a water bath at 37°C for 30-45 minutes.
Centrifuge the tube at 2,200 × g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant until approximately 100 μL remains.
Spread the cell suspension gently on a Kanamycin-added LB plate containing IPTG and X-gal solutions.
Incubate the plate in an incubator with 5% CO2 at 37°C for 12-16 hours.
Aliquot 2.5 μL Denature buffer into the PCR tube or 96 well PCR plate.
Pick up a white colony by the toothpick, then dip the colony into the Denature buffer.
Set the sample on the thermal cycler for 3 min at 95°C.
Remove the sample from the thermal cycler and add 2.5 μL Premix into it.
Set the sample on the thermal cycler for 4 h at 30°C, 10 min at 65°C, and keep it at 25°C.
Pause point: Able to store the sample at 4°C until next step for 24 h.
Add 1.5 μL CleanSEQ beads and 40 μL 80% ethanol into each well.
Vortex and spin down the mixture, then place on a magnetic rack for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully without disturbing the beads.
Add 100 μL 80% ethanol to each well again.
Repeat vortexing, spinning down, and placing on the magnetic rack for 5 minutes.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant after the second ethanol addition.
Dry the beads thoroughly until no liquid is visible.
Add 18 μL water into each well.
Vortex gently and place back on the magnetic rack for 5 minutes to separate beads from solution.
Transfer the eluted sample water carefully to the sequencing plate, avoiding transfer of beads.
Prepare the sample sheet and modify the sequencing setting accordingly.
Sequence the samples using Sanger sequencing with “RapidSeq” mode.
Analyze base called sequence data using appropriate base analyzing tools.
Check methylation status according to the reference sequence.
